The PR adds an age/allowActiveAbort gate that force-resets active session lanes with no active embedded run handle, plus focused runtime and integration coverage.

PR surface: Source +34, Tests +181. Total +215 across 3 files.

target.title: fix(logging): add time-based escape hatch to active_lane_task recovery branch
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When a session lane has an orphaned task (active task whose promise will never settle because the embedded run handle was cleaned up or abandoned) but no active embedded run handle, `recoverStuckDiagnosticSession()` unconditionally returns `keep_lane` on every heartbeat cycle. This creates an infinite recovery loop that blocks the session lane until a full Gateway restart.

Fixes [#99847](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99847).

## Why This Change Was Made

The `active_lane_task` branch (Step 6 in the recovery decision tree) has no time-based escape hatch. Steps 4-5 check `isActiveRunProgressStale()` against `staleActiveProgressAbortMs`, but Step 6 unconditionally returns `keep_lane` when `activeCount > 0` and no active embedded run handle is found.

We use `params.ageMs` directly rather than `isActiveRunProgressStale()` because the orphaned task scenario typically has `queueDepth === 0`, which would cause `isActiveRunProgressStale()` to incorrectly return false.

## User Impact

- **Before**: Orphaned lane tasks block the session lane forever (48h cron timeout), requiring manual Gateway restart
- **After**: Orphaned tasks detected as stale (ageMs ≥ 300s) trigger force-reset of the lane, releasing queued work

## Evidence

### Unit Tests (26/26 passed)
- `force-resets lane when active_lane_task ageMs exceeds stale threshold` ✅
- `keeps lane when active_lane_task ageMs is below stale threshold` ✅
- `force-resets lane when allowActiveAbort is true regardless of ageMs` ✅
- `force-resets lane with queueDepth=0 (orphaned task bypassing isActiveRunProgressStale)` ✅

### Integration Tests (8/8 passed, real command-queue runtime)
- `force-resets lane with orphaned task when ageMs exceeds stale threshold (no embedded run)` ✅
- `keeps lane with orphaned task when ageMs is below stale threshold (no embedded run)` ✅

### Runtime Verification (real runtime, no mocks)

| Scenario | ageMs | Outcome | Queue |
|----------|-------|---------|-------|
| Orphaned task below threshold | 60s | `keep_lane` | BLOCKED (expected) |
| **Orphaned task above threshold** | 360s | `release_lane / stale_lane_task released=1` | **released** (fixed) |
| allowActiveAbort=true | 10s | `release_lane / stale_lane_task` | **released** (fixed) |

Runtime logs:
```
[场景1 - 修改前] status=skipped action=keep_lane reason=active_lane_task
              → 队列任务=BLOCKED (永久阻塞)

[场景2 - 修改后] status=released action=release_lane reason=stale_lane_task released=1
              → 队列任务=released (正常释放)

[场景3 - 修改后] status=released action=release_lane reason=stale_lane_task
              → 队列任务=released (正常释放)
```
